title: Concealed-Jailbreak Detector Transfer: Does JBShield Catch Attacks It Never Saw?

original_idea.body: Layer-magnitude jailbreak trace cross-family (extends arXiv:2602.11495): extract per-layer hidden-state magnitudes on LLaMA/Mistral/Qwen, test whether the high-susceptibility band generalizes; fit a logistic probe.

theory_of_impact.reasoning: A generalizing training-free jailbreak-detection primitive is a concrete monitoring chain; falsifying it is also valuable.

accessible_complexity.reasoning: Hidden-state extraction + logistic regression on 3 small models; accessible.

narrow_scope.reasoning: Tightly scoped cross-family magnitude-gap comparison + simple probe.

counterfactual_value.reasoning: Forward-pass-only monitoring primitive on open models; independent-friendly.

low_compute.reasoning: Forward passes + logistic regression; single GPU.

novelty.reasoning: Single-model result; cross-family generalization test likely mostly novel.

novelty_assessment.reasoning: Cross-architecture generalization of the trace untested.
